resources.string: Records app text, clicks and focus events you consent to and saves them locally.

This app records text you type, taps and focus changes in other apps, and saves them on this device.

What it records: app name, screen title, non-password text, click and focus events.

What it never records: password fields, and any app on your blocklist.

Where data goes: stored locally by default. Uploading to a Telegram chat only happens if you turn it on and enter your own bot and chat ID.

You can pause capture from the ongoing notification at any time, and delete all data from Settings.

This app is intended for monitoring a device you own, with the knowledge of everyone who uses it.
